title: Neutrino mass constraints in interacting dark energy models after DESI DR2
efc_relevance: Shows that IDE relaxes Σm_ν bounds in a controlled way after DESI DR2. EFC's L2→L3 transition shares the same degeneracy direction (coupling between dark-sector dynamics and neutrino-mass posterior); the paper supplies a clean template for the Σm_ν corner of EFC parameter space.
ledger_action: Add to Gap Analysis as Σm_ν degeneracy row; cross-reference framework:CoupledDE-DM-Amendola2000 and arXiv:2604.25373; required follow-up: EFC posterior for Σm_ν under L2/L3-coupled inference.
